name: clean-diagram
title_zh: 代码库扫一遍，吐出一张能拖能改的架构图
tagline_zh: 读完仓库直接给一张自包含 HTML：工程师视角的模块依赖，另附一版给非技术同事看的白话图。
tagline_en: Reads your repo and hands back one self-contained HTML: an engineer's module map, a plain-language version for.
desc_en: Generate a clean, self-contained HTML architecture map from a codebase — an engineer view, an optional plain-language view for non-engineers, and a short list of gaps worth a look. In the page, nodes can be dragged, renamed, added, connected and deleted, and the Mermaid source exported back out. Use when the user asks for an architecture diagram, system diagram, module map, or "explain how this co
why_zh: 图是给人改的，不是给人看的。所以它输出可编辑的 HTML 而不是死图片，缺口清单也一并给你。
why_en: The diagram is meant to be edited, not just viewed — so it ships as editable HTML, not a dead image, with the gap list attached.
limit_zh: 只认静态可读的代码结构，动态调用、运行时依赖、跨服务链路它看不出来；白话版是它自己转述的，术语翻错得你自己改。
limit_en: Static structure only — no runtime calls, dynamic deps, or cross-service traces. The plain-language view is its own paraphrase, so fix mistranslated.
title_en: Turns a codebase into a draggable HTML architecture map
